items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Old man Webber heard me playing clarinet.

ctx.x: Well, let's see. Did you play full time with that Stand It All band? Oh, yeah. I was employed in the band that imported me there. Old man Webber heard me playing clarinet.
And he had me imported into the plant, you see. And you played every day there? No, no, no. No, no. Just… You were a still worker.
